U1_finding: U1 uncertainty has strong incremental value (0.505) and is architecture-robust (3/3), but FAILS the noisy-TV control: it allocates verification to high-uncertainty IRREDUCIBLE items. Raw uncertainty does not distinguish reducible from irreducible uncertainty, so it wastes budget. This is a genuine decision-value null, not instrumentation. The one permitted bounded repair (a reducibility-aware uncertainty) essentially reduces to the N1 mechanism; not executed now to avoid gate-chasing.

evidence_ladder.controlled_bed_plausibility: Phase 4B (all three admitted on calibrated battery)
evidence_ladder.real_data_canary: Campaign 2 (N1 positive, P1R positive, U1 pruned)

phase6_confirmation_decision: N1 and P1R (canary_positive) are LICENSED for one bounded independent-confirmation experiment each, increasing >=2 of: data-source breadth (add a second real dataset e.g. KMNIST/CIFAR or STARSS23), implementation breadth (a materially independent mechanism implementation), context/unit breadth. U1 is pruned; no confirmation. Cluster B (R1+P1R) may use P1R real-data admission authority; Cluster A/C await their own real-data canaries (V1/K1/M1/A1/S1 have only mechanics evidence, which does not license a cluster).
claim_ceiling: real-data CANARY evidence for N1 and P1R: stronger than controlled-bed, but single-source (MNIST-family) and NOT yet independently confirmed. Not scientific confirmation and not activation. Activation authority remains FALSE.
